31u001.questiontext:
Given the `makefile` file:

```makefile
CC = g++
CXXFLAGS = -O2 -std=c++14
LDFLAGS = -love
OUT = file

BINDIR = bin
SRCDIR = src
OBJDIR = obj

all: prepare $(OUT)

prepare:
   mkdir -p $(OBJDIR) $(BINDIR)

clean:
   rm -f $(OBJDIR)/*.o $(BINDIR)/*

help:
   @echo Usage:
   echo make - build application
   echo make clean - remove build artifacts
   echo make help - show help

$(OUT): $(OBJDIR)/first.o $(OBJDIR)/second.o $(OBJDIR)/main.o
    $(CC) $(OBJDIR)/first.o $(OBJDIR)/second.o $(OBJDIR)/main.o -o $(BINDIR)/$(OUT) $(LDFLAGS)
    
$(OBJDIR)/first.o:
    $(CC) -c $(SRCDIR)/first.cpp $(CXXFLAGS) -o $(OBJDIR)/first.o

$(OBJDIR)/second.o:
    $(CC) -c $(SRCDIR)/second.cpp $(CXXFLAGS) -o $(OBJDIR)/second.o

$(OBJDIR)/main.o:
    $(CC) -c $(SRCDIR)/main.cpp $(CXXFLAGS) -o $(OBJDIR)/main.o
```

What version of the C++ language is used to build the application?

001.questiontext:
Given an array __a__ of __N__ integers. Print all even elements.

### Input data

The first line contains the integer N. The second line contains N integers.

### Output data

In one line, separated by spaces, print all even elements of the array __a__. If there are no even elements, print `oops`.

002.questiontext:
Given an array __a__ of __N__ integers and a number __M__. Find the position of the number __M__ in the array.

### Input data

The first line contains the integer N. The second line contains N integers. The third line contains the integer __M__.

### Output data

Print the position of the number __M__ in the array __a__. If the number is not in the array, print -1. If the number occurs multiple times, print the smallest index.

003.questiontext:
Given an array __a__ of __N__ integers. Determine how many elements in this array are strictly greater than their neighbors.

### Input data

The first line contains the integer N. The second line contains N integers.

### Output data

Print the number of elements that are strictly greater than their neighbors.

004.questiontext:
Given an array __a__ of __N__ integers. Cyclically shift the elements of the array to the left by one element (the 0th element becomes the last, the 1st becomes the 0th, ..., that is, the array `{3, 5, 7, 9}` becomes `{5, 7, 9, 3}`).

### Input data

The first line contains the integer N. The second line contains N integers.

### Output data

Print the elements of the transformed array in one line, separated by spaces.

005.questiontext:
Given an array __a__ of __N__ integers and an integer __B__. Remove all occurrences of the number __B__ from the array __a__.

### Input data

The first line contains the integer __N__. The second line contains __N__ integers. The third line contains the number __B__.

### Output data

Print the elements of the transformed array in one line, separated by spaces. If there are no elements left in the array after the transformation, print `oops!`.

- a method `DistanceTo` that takes a constant reference to an object of the class `Point` and returns the distance between the current point and the passed one (the formula for the distance between two points in space is $$d = \sqrt{(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2 + (z_2 - z_1)^2}$$)
